# Event Catering | إيفنت كاترينج

> Hospitality packages platform in Oman for government, corporate, and private events.
> منصة باقات ضيافة في عُمان للجهات الحكومية والشركات والمناسبات الخاصة.

## What we offer

- Browse curated hospitality packages (official, corporate, openings)
- Customize guests, schedule, and services
- Submit a request for quote coordination with catering partners
- Muscat and surrounding areas in Oman

- [Home](https://www.event-om.com/): Brand overview and how Event Catering works
- [Packages](https://www.event-om.com/packages): All hospitality packages with indicative pricing
